text:
Introduction
This procedure details the minor maintenance procedure, which
 are performed on a 3-month basis as indicated by the M3. This procedure documents the 2nd. level of maintenance performed on this type
 of transformer.
Safety Precautions
Safety fence with caution marks surrounded the work area is required.
Before switching off the transformer listen and check for any abnormal
 sounds from main tank, De hyolrating breather, control cabinet of
 transformer, control cabinet of Tap changer and accessories this means
 that: 
 - A rattling sound indicates loose bolts. 
 - Repetitive scraping sound indicate a warn fan or oil pump bearing.
The low, medium, high voltage CB's of the transformer must be isolated and
 proper earthing at the 3 sides required.
Wearing safety helmet and safety belt.
Use only fiberglass ladder.
Personal carrying the work must be trained and qualified by some one who
 is.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool kit/set, including a torque wrench,
Air blower, Lubricating grease (light grade),
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes,
Work to be Carried Out
Bushing
Check the porcelain for
 cracking and other damaged and clean it.
Check that there is no
 overheating of the terminals and any part at the bushing.
Check for any oil leakage
 from the bushings.
Check the pressure of oil in
 the oil pressure gauges 500, 220, 132 kV bushings and compare it with chart of pressure and temperature (P-T) chart, add
 oil if the pressure is lower than the reference curve limit (M.N curve) fig.1. The case
 must be to be located between MN and BC curves.
Oil level, Oil Leakage
Read and record the value on the oil level gauge of the
 transformer and tap
 changer check that the oil level readings are correct for the atmospheric
 temperature.
Check that their is no oil leakage from the transform tank,
 valves, pipes, gagues, gaskets joints, welds, radiators etc and retight any
 loosen connection.

De Hyolrating Breather
The silica gel absorbent inside the breather bottle is
 normally nagenta blue, but turns pink if excessive moisture is present, dry

Check that the sight-glass level of the sealing oil in the
 oil cup is between the high and low mark, it must be corrected it all times.
Control Cabinet
Clean the control cabinet with air

Inspect the terminally and check

Check the gasket of the control

 and check that they operates in good condition
Tap changer
Check the oil level of tap changer.
Check the oil level in the gearbox
 or grease and fill if needed.
Operate the Tap changer and check
 for any abnormal sounds or vibration during operation.
Check that the step position

 the same is in the indicator at the tap cover of tap changer. Record the No.
 of tap changer operation from the counter and check that the operation
 counters function correctly.
Check the gasket of the control
